versions.changelog:
Initial release of guaikei-douyin-keyword-search-to-video-list.

- Provides tools for fetching and analyzing public Douyin data, including keyword search, author video list, video comments, and hot topics.
- Supports structured queries for video keywords, trending charts, author posts, and comment analysis.
- Emphasizes data safety (no login required, no risk of account issues), high performance, and easy integration (Node.js CLI, pure JSON output).
- Includes detailed usage examples, input collection rules, execution and output conventions, and guidance for proper scenario routing.
- Requires GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN for API access.
